Maria Chen: Heads up — I'm OOO Monday for the public holiday. Need someone to cover Redwood-API oncall 08:00–18:00 PT. I can swap and take Tue instead or cover an evening shift later in the week. Leaving quick handoff notes below if someone can pick up.

Jake R: I can take the 08:00–12:00 slice (happy to jump in early). @Sylvie K can you do 12:00–18:00?

Sylvie K: Yep I can do 12–18. @Maria Chen for the swap do you want me to mark the rota and calendar?

Maria Chen: Yes please mark the rota and move the calendar invite. Quick handoff notes (short):
• Environment: prod cluster us-west-2 runs primary Redwood-API.
• Known flakiness: qcache evictions on midday load spikes — check /dash/kv-cache when latency > 200ms.
• Recent deploy: rollout v2.4.1 yesterday, watch for 504 spikes on batching endpoints.
• Escalation: pager -> eng-oncall -> eng-sre. If rate increases >25% open a paged incident.

oncall-bot: Swap request recorded. Pending manual confirmation on rota.

Alan T: If anything overnight bubbles up (nightly jobs) I can take pager for 00:00–06:00 on Mon night — otherwise I'm around for quick help remotely.

Jake R: Rota updated and calendar moved. I added a brief note in the event with Maria's handoff. :thumbsup:

Sylvie K: All set on my side, added a link to the KV cache dashboard in the event notes: https://dash.redwood.example/kvcache (ping me if you want me to run a quick smoke test before 12:00).

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — I owe you coffee. Leaving my phone if you need anything urgent: +1-555-0123. :wave:

Jake R: Thanks! Enjoy the day off.

Sylvie K: Have a good one!

oncall-bot: Rota confirmed: Jake R 08:00–12:00, Sylvie K 12:00–18:00, Alan T 00:00–06:00 (standby).
